title: Code and equations
p: Keep a useful script, document an API or work through an equation. Code blocks provide syntax highlighting and line numbers, while LaTeX equations sit naturally alongside your writing.
Use inline code for commands, filenames and function names: brew install ripgrep or ~/.zshrc. Wrap text in backticks as you type, or select it and press ⌘ ⌃ C.

ul.li: Type three backticks at the start of a line, then Space or Enter. Add a language, as in ```python, to select it immediately.
Choose Code block from the slash menu, or press ⌘ ⌥ C.
Use the block menu to turn an existing paragraph into code.

p: Inside a code block, Tab inserts four spaces, Shift-Tab reduces indentation, and Enter starts a new line. Markdown formatting is disabled and pasted content is treated as plain text.
Hover over a code block to choose its language. The searchable picker supports more than seventy languages.

p: Click the caption above a code block to give it a filename or a useful description. Long lines scroll horizontally by default. Enable wrapping in the block's controls when you would rather read them without scrolling.

pre.caption: Example error log
pre.code: 2026-11-01 09:42:17.381 ERROR [save] No space left on device. The document remains unsaved; free some space and save again.

ul.li: The copy button copies the complete code block without its line numbers.
Use the triangle on the left to fold a long block.
The document theme controls line numbers. Craft, Feishu and Obsidian show them; Notion does not.

p: Type LaTeX between dollar signs: $a^2+b^2=c^2$ becomes a^2+b^2=c^2 when you type the closing dollar sign. Double-dollar delimiters work too.
You can also choose Equation from the slash menu. Press Esc to finish editing. Click an existing equation to edit it again; invalid input is marked without damaging the document.
The quadratic equation ax^2 + bx + c = 0 has solutions x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}. When \Delta = b^2 - 4ac < 0, it has no real solutions.
